chapter.verse: A thukkik Pasian, a thukkik Pasian, Topa aw, na hehna hong lakkhia in.
Tho in leitung thukhenpa aw, a kiphasak mite tungah amau ngah dinga kilawm pia ta in!
Topa aw, migilote bang tanvei, migilote bang tanvei lungdamin omom lai ding ahi uh hiam?
Gamtatsiate, bang tanvei kihisak lai ding uh a, a siat gamtatna uh bang tanvei kisialhpih lai ding ahi uh hiam?
T opa aw, amaute in nangma mite sugawp uh a, nangma luahte gimsak uh hi.
Amaute in meigong numei leh khualmi thatlum uh a, pa nei lote suamlum uh hi;
amaute in, “ Topa in mu lo hi; Jakob Pasian in thei lo hi,” hong ci uh hi.
Thei tel un, mi lungsim mawl pente aw! Lung pillote aw, cik ciangin pil ding na hi uh hiam?
I bil a bawlpa in khua za lo ding ahi hiam? I mit a piang sakpa in, khua mu lo ding ahi hiam?
Minamte a thuhilhpa in, mi thuhilh lo ding ahi hiam? Mihingte tungah theihtheihna a hilh Topa in, mihingte’ ngaihsutna, amaute pen husan’ khat bang bek ahihna a thei hi.
Topa aw, migilote’ adingin gum khat a kitawh hun matengin, haksat hun a tawlngak theih nadingin na thukham na hilh mi, na thuhilh mi in mi nuamsa ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite nusia lo ding a, ama luahte paidak lo ding hi;
bang hang hiam cih leh thutang pen thumante tungah hong tungkik ding a, lungsim thutang khempeuh in amah zui ding uh hi.
Kei adingin migilote do dingin kua kipan ahi hiam? Kei adingin siatna bawlte’ lang khatah kua ding ahi hiam?
Topa in kei hong huh lo hi leh, gamkhing sungah ka tung khin ta ding hi.
Topa aw, “Ka khe taal,” ci-a ka ngaihsut ciangin na itna kip in kei hong kaito hi.
Ka lungsim ngaihsutna a tam ciangin kei nong hehnem a, nong lungdam sak hi.
Sih nadinga ngeina a bawl, a gilo gam ukte, nang tawh kipawl thei ding ahi hiam?
Amaute in thuman mihoihte thah sawm uh a, a mawh baang lo mite, sihna daan thuak sak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in keima munkip, keima Pasian, ka belh suangpi suak khin ta hi.
Amah in amau mawhnate amau tung mah-ah tungsak kikin, a git lohna hangun amaute maimang sak ding hi; Topa, i Pasian in amaute maimang sak ding hi.
